svg.title: The two waits in isolation
svg.desc: Four probe runs on the RTX 5060 Ti for each of vLLM 0.32, make-room alone and make-room with the prefill hold: in panel a, the KV case, the voice turn's first token while two agent requests of 18k tokens hold the pool (vLLM 0.32 4,900–4,971 ms; make-room 219–290 ms; the prefill hold 216–294 ms); in panel b, the prefill case, its first token to its 16th while three agent prefills of 10k tokens run, the 16th at vLLM 0.32 1,220–1,529 ms; make-room 1,211–1,528 ms; the prefill hold 536–615 ms.
svg.text: two agent requests of 18k tokens fill the pool
three agent prefills of 10k tokens run
